args.body: Hi Dora! I visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. It's great that you have a personal site with your contact information clearly displayed. However, I think your website could benefit from more content — right now it's quite minimal. Consider adding sections about yourself, your interests, projects, or work experience to give visitors a better sense of who you are. Adding some visuals or design elements could also make it more engaging. Keep up the good work!

Hi Eve! I visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I love that your blog is centered around hiking — that's a wonderful hobby to write about! I'd suggest expanding your blog with more content, such as trail reviews, hiking tips, gear recommendations, or photos from your adventures. This would make it more engaging and useful for fellow hiking enthusiasts. Looking forward to seeing more posts from you!
